programmes.d: When the homeless occupy a city library to escape freezing temperatures, it triggers an extreme reaction by local authorities and media. Starring Alec Baldwin, Emilio Estevez and Taylor Schilling.
A reporter returns to his Florida hometown to investigate a case involving a death row inmate.

After encountering and eventually being accepted by a Native American tribe, Dunbar's loyalties are put to the test when the army threatens his new home, forcing him to choose between white America or the natives he now calls his people.
John Malkovich, Gary Sinise and Sherilyn Fenn shine in this contemporary remake of the beloved classic about a nomadic farm worker who looks after his dimwitted, gentle-giant friend.

Travis Henderson, an aimless drifter who has been missing for four years, wanders out of the desert and must reconnect with society, himself, his life, and his family.

Jack Lemmon and George C. Scott lead an all-star cast in this compelling look at the jury deliberations in a murder trial for which a conviction means sending a young man to death row. Adapted from the classic 1957 United Artists drama.

When long-time married couple Ruth (Diane Keaton) and Alex (Morgan Freeman) decide to move away from New York City, they must contend with eccentric open house guests, their pushy realtor niece, and the health of their beloved family dog.
After moving from India to Canada, 15-year-old Jeffrey (Ryan Reynolds) finds new purpose when a developer threatens his aunt’s home. Drawing on his roots, he rallies the community to fight back.
